source.citation: Voorheis, J., Colmer, J., Houghton, K., Lyubich, E., Munro, M., Scalera, C., and Withrow, J. (2025). "The Public-Use Gridded Environmental Impacts Frame."

n_noise.label: Raw (noise-injected) counts
n_noise.description: Direct output of the noise-infusion process. Unbiased, but can be negative (8.3% of grid-cell rows in 2022, min -8).

n_noise_postprocessed.label: Post-processed counts
n_noise_postprocessed.description: Small noisy cells pooled by race within each 1-degree grid point and redistributed, residual negatives clamped to zero. Always non-negative.

race_ethnicity.label: Race and ethnicity
race_ethnicity.note: Hispanic takes precedence; all other categories are non-Hispanic.

age_group.label: Age group
age_group.label_source: Voorheis et al. (2026), Review of Environmental Economics and Policy 20(2), p. 315
age_group.footnote: Age groups are labelled as described in Voorheis et al. (2026): under 18, 18–64, and 65+. The underlying data files use the strings "Under 18", "19-65", and "Over 65" for these same three groups; the codes are shown alongside the labels wherever a query is exported.

income_decile.label: Household income decile
income_decile.note: Equal-count national deciles of household AGI, recomputed each year. A decile count is a distributional profile, not an income measure.

cbsa.label: Metro / micropolitan area
cbsa.caveat: Metro and micropolitan areas do not cover the entire country. Cells outside any CBSA are excluded, so CBSA totals do not sum to the national total.

zcta.label: ZIP Code Tabulation Area
zcta.caveat: ZCTAs approximate postal delivery routes, not neighborhoods or any administrative unit. High demand, weak conceptual fit.

ageracesex.label: Population by age, race, and sex

raceincome.label: Population by race and income decile
